bio: No3 Restaurant and Bistro is set within a stunning contemporary building, just a stone’s throw from many public transport links.  At No3, overlooking the beautiful Clapham Common, London, they pride themselves on offering a charming dining experience in exquisite surroundings. Their chefs combine contemporary flare with conventional staples to create a variety of seasonal menus.  The classic traditional Afternoon Tea menu includes Truffle Egg Mayonnaise and Tea Smoked Salmon sandwiches, scones with jam and cream plus a daily selection of sweet treats.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
